checks.name: GF(11) own tables form a field (assoc/distrib/inverses)
header: q, N=L=(q^6-1)/(q-1)
points normalized (first nonzero coord = 1) and pairwise distinct
every stored point satisfies Q(X)=X0X4+X1X5+X2X6-X3^2=0 (own GF arithmetic)
every point on q+1 lines; every line has q+1 distinct points
every line satisfies the six Tits equations on Pluecker coordinates
every line = normalized span of its first two points (q+1 points, same set)
lines pairwise distinct
H(q) connected, eccentricity of v is 6 (lines) / 5 (points)
checks.detail: max line dist 6, max point dist 5

checks.name: Pi: X0+cX4=0 with -c a non-square (c chosen)
|P_S| = (q+1)(q^3+1) (points of H(q) in Pi)
|S| = q^3+1 lines of H(q) inside Pi
S is a spread of P_S: every point of P_S on exactly one S-line
pairwise opposite: no line of H(q) meets two lines of S
checks.detail: max S-lines met by one line: 1

checks.name: v (through e1,e6) exists and lies in S
|L_v| = q(q+1) lines != v meeting v
points at distance <= 3 from v are exactly X2=X5=0 (and there are (q+1)(q^2+1))
free points = not in Pi and at distance 5 from v; count q^3(q^2-1)
G(a,b)=(c0a+c1b)(a^2+cb^2)-b^3 zero-free on F^2\0 for some (c0,c1)
W lines are distinct over different z (no line counted twice)
W lines are not in S
no point of a W line at distance <= 3 from v
each free point lies on exactly one W line
each W line meets Pi in one point which is off v (nu defined)
nu constant on each spread line != v (and well defined there)
each spread line != v meets q+1 or 0 W-lines (one per point)
sum over spread lines of W-incidences = |W| (each W line meets one spread line)
exactly q^2 spread lines != v meet no W-line
the spread lines meeting no W-line are exactly those with nu = 0
R_L = L_v + W + S_0 has q^4+q^2+q lines (disjoint parts)
every point of H(q) lies on a line of R_L
R_L is a dual segment set: each line of R_L has at most one point shared with other R_L lines
maximal: no line outside R_L can be added (every outside line violates)
P_S is a segment set: for each p, at most one line through p contains other P_S points
checks.detail: max lines-with-other-points through a P_S point: 1

checks.name: |P_S| = (q+1)(q^3+1) and it is a segment set of that size
